subject: Shortfall coverage request & stepdown policy clarification
messages:
From: Maya Chen <maya@fastretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term coverage ask — unexpected weekday surge

Hi Hannah,

We had a sudden spike this morning during a campaign push and blew past our soft quota for the month. Our engineering team pushed a hotfix that increased traffic, and we expect elevated traffic for the next 36–48 hours while we stabilize.

Could Redwood temporarily extend a shortfall coverage window (48 hrs) to avoid throttling while we roll this back? We understand there may be overrun charges — if possible we’d like a prorated rate or a short-term blended rate while we normalize.

Attached is our hourly usage CSV for today. Happy to hop on a call if needed.

Thanks,
Maya Chen
Director of Ops, FastRetail Inc.
Attachments: fastretail_usage_apr18.csv (text/csv, 48KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term coverage ask — unexpected weekday surge

Thanks for the heads up, Maya — appreciate the detailed usage file.

Short answer: we can provide a 48-hour temporary headroom to keep you from throttling, but there are a few options and approvals needed on our side. Two paths we typically offer:

• Immediate temporary headroom (no contract): 48 hrs of elevated quota with pay-as-you-go overrun at standard rates.
• Short-term coverage MOU: 48 hrs of headroom + a one-time account credit or blended overrun rate (requires finance sign-off).

To move to the MOU option quickly, please confirm you can sign a simple one-page MOU agreeing to retrospective invoicing and a commitment to remediate traffic within 48 hrs. If you want the blended rate, let us know a target effective discount (e.g., 15–25%).

I’ll loop in Ben (billing) and Dev (account lead) to check the finance/credit limit. If you’re available, let’s do a 20-min call now so we can lock the path.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Short-term coverage ask — approval options

Looping myself in — quick notes:

• Approvals: I can sign a one-off MOU for up to $10k in provisional coverage/credits. Anything above needs RevOps sign-off.
• Pricing fallback: If they want blended overrun, 20% discount off list overrun rate is doable for a single 48-hr window; otherwise standard PAYG applies.
• Billing: We’ll invoice the overrun on the next cycle; credits applied against that invoice if MOU is signed.

If Hannah wants us to proceed with the MOU path, I can prepare the draft PDF (proposed_mou_shortfall_coverage.pdf) and send for Maya’s signature.

-Ben
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term coverage ask — temporary headroom approved (pending MOU)

Maya — quick update. We approved a 48-hour temporary headroom window and can offer a blended overrun rate if FastRetail signs a short MOU. Proposed terms:

• Duration: 48 hours from the moment we lift throttles (we can implement within 30 mins).
• Coverage: up to an additional 3x your nominal soft quota for that window.
• Blended overrun: 20% discount off standard overrun rate (single application for this incident).
• Rollback: FastRetail commits to remediation within 48 hrs; if elevated traffic persists beyond the window, we’ll revert to standard throttling and invoice PAYG for any extra consumption.
• Invoice & credit: Overrun will be invoiced next cycle; if MOU signed, we’ll apply the agreed credit/discount before invoice is finalized.

I’ve attached a draft MOU for signature (proposed_mou_shortfall_coverage.pdf). If you confirm, Ben will route the DocuSign and we’ll lift throttles immediately.

If you prefer not to sign, we can still lift throttles temporarily but at standard PAYG terms.

—Hannah
From: Maya Chen <maya@fastretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, ops-team@fastretail.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term coverage ask — temporary headroom approved (pending MOU)

Thank you — we’ll sign the MOU. Team just confirmed rollback steps will be executed; we expect traffic to normalize within the 48-hr window.

Please send the DocuSign link and lift throttles when ready. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Maya
Maya Chen
Director of Ops, FastRetail Inc.
Attachments: signed_intent_note.txt (text/plain, 1KB)
